tagline: 宝丽来一次成像相机，1969 年发布
description: 宝丽来于1969年推出的一次成像相机。配备114mm, f/9.2 3-element coated glass or uncoated plastic.。快门速度Electronic; range about 10s-1/500s。使用Peel-apart 100-Series Land Pack Films (discontinued) or Fujifilm FP-100C (still manufactured).。

specs.胶片/画幅: Peel-apart 100-Series Land Pack Films (discontinued) or Fujifilm FP-100C (still manufactured).
specs.镜头: 114mm, f/9.2 3-element coated glass or uncoated plastic.
specs.英文简介: The Polaroid Colorpack II was a rigid plastic bodied instant camera, made between 1969-1972.
